ns2:course.label: Vector and Tensor Analysis
ns2:course.description: (MATH 381) Vector spaces, transformation properties, covariant and contravariant tensors, and differential geometry of surfaces; applications to relativity theory. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. 4 hours of credit requires approval of the instructor and completion of additional work of substance. Prerequisite: MATH 243 or MATH 380 or equivalent; or consent of instructor.
